evaluations.question: What is the difference between Point Tracker and Planar Tracker in DaVinci Resolve?
evaluations.label: pass

real_world_sources.solution_summary: Official Fusion page distinguishes tracker types: 2D tracker follows most moving objects; Planar tracker tracks image planes/flat objects, ideal for replacing signs or screens; 3D camera tracking for camera motion.
Official Color page tracker (Point Tracker) animates Power Windows to follow moving objects. Choose options matching camera movement, move playhead to beginning, click track forward.
